model.title: Making America's Food Safer Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Tommy Tuberville (R-AL)

summary.text: The bill would expand the FDA's authority to protect food safety in several ways: it would allow the FDA to order the destruction of imported foods that pose significant health risks without giving importers the option to export them elsewhere; it would enable the FDA to share food safety information more readily with state and local authorities during outbreaks and recalls; and it would extend the FDA's voluntary audit program to domestic food facilities, allowing audit results to be used to guide inspections and other safety activities.
